subdivision_of_building: Two sections of the existing exterior playground.
decision_conditions: The development, by reason of the height, siting and elevated vantage point of Set 1 of the play equipment, positioned adjacent to the northern boundary with the residential property 'Sanatan, Parkway', results in a harmful perception of overlooking and loss of privacy to the occupiers of that dwelling. The 1.4m platform height enables users (particularly older children) to visually overlook parts of the neighbouring rear garden and conservatory area, causing an unacceptable loss of residential amenity. The harm is exacerbated by the lack of adequate mitigation. Accordingly, the proposal fails to safeguard the amenities of neighbouring occupiers, contrary to policy DMHB 11 of the Hillingdon Local Plan: Part Two - Development Management Policies (2020), Policy D3 of the London Plan (2021) and paragraph 135(f) of the NPPF (2024)

The decision to REFUSE planning permission has been taken having regard to all relevant planning legislation, regulations, guidance, circulars and Council policies, including The Human Rights Act (1998) (HRA 1998) which makes it unlawful for the Council to act incompatibly with Convention rights, specifically Article 6 (right to a fair hearing); Article 8 (right to respect for private and family life); Article 1 of the First Protocol (protection of property) and Article 14 (prohibition of discrimination).

The decision to REFUSE planning permission has been taken having regard to the policies and proposals in the Hillingdon Local Plan Part 1 (2012) and Part 2 (2020) set out below, including Supplementary Planning Guidance, and to all relevant material considerations, including The London Plan (2021) and national guidance.
description: Installation of two sets of permanent activity play equipment in the existing playground. Part of existing tarmac surfaces to be replaced with eco-mulch soft play surfacing. Part retrospective.
